test.create_query: CREATE TABLE fmt_write_src ENGINE = Memory AS SELECT * FROM hits_10m_single WHERE WatchID % 10 = 0
CREATE TABLE fmt_write_{format} ENGINE = File({format}, '/dev/null') AS hits_10m_single
CREATE TABLE fmt_write_pq_{parquet_compression} ENGINE = File(Parquet, '/dev/null') SETTINGS output_format_parquet_compression_method = '{parquet_compression}' AS hits_10m_single
CREATE TABLE fmt_write_pq_noindex ENGINE = File(Parquet, '/dev/null') SETTINGS output_format_parquet_write_bloom_filter = 0, output_format_parquet_write_page_index = 0 AS hits_10m_single
CREATE TABLE fmt_write_orc_none ENGINE = File(ORC, '/dev/null') SETTINGS output_format_orc_compression_method = 'none' AS hits_10m_single
CREATE TABLE fmt_check_{format} ENGINE = File({format}, 'formats_hits_write/check.{format}') AS hits_10m_single

CREATE TABLE fmt_check_pq_{parquet_compression} ENGINE = File(Parquet, 'formats_hits_write/pq_{parquet_compression}.parquet') SETTINGS output_format_parquet_compression_method = '{parquet_compression}' AS hits_10m_single

CREATE TABLE fmt_check_pq_noindex ENGINE = File(Parquet, 'formats_hits_write/pq_noindex.parquet') SETTINGS output_format_parquet_write_bloom_filter = 0, output_format_parquet_write_page_index = 0 AS hits_10m_single
CREATE TABLE fmt_check_orc_none ENGINE = File(ORC, 'formats_hits_write/orc_none.orc') SETTINGS output_format_orc_compression_method = 'none' AS hits_10m_single
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO fmt_check_{format} SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO fmt_check_pq_{parquet_compression} SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO fmt_check_pq_noindex SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO fmt_check_orc_none SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1

SELECT throwIf(count() != 14 OR countIf((c, h) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM fmt_write_src)) != 0) FROM (SELECT _table, count() AS c, sum(cityHash64(*)) AS h FROM merge(currentDatabase(), '^fmt_check_') GROUP BY _table)

SELECT throwIf(groupArray((_file, arrayDistinct(arrayMap(c -> c.compression, columns)), arrayExists(r -> arrayExists(c -> c.bloom_filter_bytes > 0, r.columns), row_groups))) != [ ('check.Parquet', ['ZSTD'], 1), ('pq_lz4.parquet', ['LZ4'], 1), ('pq_noindex.parquet', ['ZSTD'], 0), ('pq_none.parquet', ['UNCOMPRESSED'], 1), ('pq_snappy.parquet', ['SNAPPY'], 1)]) FROM (SELECT _file, columns, row_groups FROM file('formats_hits_write/*.{{Parquet,parquet}}', ParquetMetadata) ORDER BY _file)
test.query: INSERT INTO fmt_write_{format} SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src
INSERT INTO fmt_write_pq_{parquet_compression} SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src
INSERT INTO fmt_write_pq_noindex SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src
INSERT INTO fmt_write_orc_none SELECT * FROM fmt_write_src
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS fmt_check_{format}, fmt_write_{format} SYNC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS fmt_check_pq_{parquet_compression}, fmt_write_pq_{parquet_compression} SYNC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS fmt_check_pq_noindex, fmt_write_pq_noindex, fmt_check_orc_none, fmt_write_orc_none, fmt_write_src SYNC
